programme.desc: S05 E04 — Cozy Lake House Reno A woman aims to renovate her Rogers, Ark., home where the backyard is treacherous and unusable, so Dave and Jenny look to take advantage of her amazing views to create the ultimate lakeside hangout for her family.
programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Drab Fixer to Charming Cottage A first-time homeowner is excited about her English cottage-style renovation that she can enjoy with her friends; as demolition gets underway, Dave and Jenny uncover an unexpected challenge when they discover her crawl space is filled with water.
programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous

programme.desc: S05 E05 — Small Historic Home Meets Full Potential A young family of three's small century-old home is in desperate need of a revival; the house is a piece of Bentonville, Ark., history; Dave and Jenny face big challenges as they aim to bring it back to life.
programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous

programme.desc: S05 E06 — A Grand Makeover Meets the Marrs A ballroom dancing California couple is ready for a renovation and for the Marrs, it's their most unique home yet; Dave and Jenny take on the project as they aim to create a bathroom spa-retreat, a chef's kitchen and a formal entryway.
programme.title: Fixer to Fabulous

programme.desc: S02 E01 — The Future of Kitchen Design A flashy Vegas realtor has big expectations for a dream kitchen that looks nothing like anything traditional, but when the homeowner's scammed out of his custom cabinets, the entire project nearly falls apart.
programme.title: Sin City Rehab

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Bathroom of the Misfit Tub Charlie and Courtney transform a primary suite for a couple whose bathroom is falling apart; after a history of wayward contractors, they put their faith in Charlie to battle termites, mold and floating rafters to bring their dream retreat to life.
programme.title: Botched Homes

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Ruined Retreat Charlie and his crew overhaul a DIY kitchen with no running hot water, exposed wiring held together by a stuffed python and other questionable design; Charlie and Courtney transform a hideous and hazardous black and white checkerboard bathroom.
programme.title: Botched Homes

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Welcome to the Swamp Charlie transforms a college frat house into an elegant family home.
programme.title: Botched Homes

programme.desc: S279 E06 — It's a Huge Turn On Boston lawyers are looking for a new home in Florida; he wants resort-style amenities while she prefers a quiet place on the beach, and if they can focus on the properties instead of their attraction to each other, they might just find a place.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E09 — The Hollywood Steamroller A real estate agent tries to steamroll his easygoing husband on their search for a home near West Hollywood, California; it sparks a battle over budget, space, and just how far out they're willing to go.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E01 — The Parisian and the Pessimist With their current house crumbling, a Parisian and his wife need to find a new place fast in Indianapolis. The pressure's on to find the character-filled home they want, but her pessimistic practicality may find issues with every house they see.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S280 E01 — Rich in the '90s A pop culture enthusiast couple wants retro style for their first home in Kansas City, Missouri; they're looking for a place that has a '90s vibe, but finding a nostalgic home that isn't too old or in need of a major overhaul may be a challenge.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S276 E08 — Seeking the Cat's Meow After seeing their daughter off to college, empty nesters are relocating for her new job to Greenville, N.C.; they're ready to focus on their creative interests and their two cats, but they're at odds on style, price and location.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S272 E04 — I Can Fire Them, Too A couple on a path to retirement leaves Austin, Texas, for a lower cost of living and a place that's closer to family in Missouri; they know exactly what they want, and they aren't afraid to fire their agent if she can't deliver.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S277 E06 — With or Without You A couple's ready to find a place near Pittsburgh. They just finished turning their last house into character filled perfection, but when one suggests another renovation, the other threatens to move on with or without him.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S271 E08 — Making Music in Woodstock A couple looks for a home that matches their quirky personalities in Upstate New York; he's a music producer and wants space to build a recording studio, but she's more concerned with finding a house that's suited to start their family.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S275 E02 — Bring Your Daughter to House Hunting Day A single mother wants to give her 10-year-old daughter the home she never had in the Atlanta suburbs; with her daughter cheering her on and her cautious mom pumping the brakes, every house they see becomes a three-generation debate.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: Room for Zoomies A cosmetologist returns home to fulfill his late father's wish of owning his own property in Detroit; he's having a hard time finding the perfect old charmer, but his best friend is along and thinks he should consider a condo.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S274 E06 — Massachusetts Roots or Rental Due to a military relocation, a family needs to move to Massachusetts fast; knowing that this location is temporary, he wants to rent, but after a recent health scare, she's eager to buy a home and set down roots.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S274 E11 — A Bear of a House Hunt A Florida couple sold their home faster than expected, and now they're in a hurry find a new place in Sarasota; one's looking for turnkey at under a million, but the other wants to spend more on something that will give them the best return.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S271 E38 — Buffalo Hunt A Florida couple experiences culture shock as they relocate to Buffalo, New York. He wants a large, historic gem located in the center of town, but she thinks a smaller, newer home in the suburbs is a more practical choice.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S269 E04 — Mom or Monster A Virginia entrepreneur is in the process of buying her first home and brings her opinionated mother along for help; she's set on finding a grand house to show off her success, but Mom thinks she should look for something smaller and more practical.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S280 E06 — Show Dog House A buyer with high expectations keeps his show dog's needs top priority as they search for a home in Kansas City, Missouri. He's on a first-time buyer's budget, so he'll need to decide whether to compromise on price, location or his dog's demands.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S259 E07 — Blending Homes in Huntsville An Alabama couple is tired of being long distance and looks to blend their families with a home in Huntsville, Ala.; he's a retired Marine who prefers to spend as little as possible on a ranch, but she's a successful exec who wants luxury and a pool.
programme.title: House Hunters

Dom turns his hand to replacing the battered roof.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: S7 E5 — Episode 5 Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. Owner Jackie treasures the figurines, lovingly crafted by her older brother Andrew who tragically died in an accident at the tender age of 18. After over 40 years on display, the unglazed figurines are crumbling and in dire need of repair.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Sweetheart's Portrait, Tin Plate Rocket and Lucky Leather Purse Paper conservator Louise Drover rescues a water-damaged pastel portrait of a young couple. Owner Simon cherishes the portrait of him and his late wife Vicky, captured whilst on holiday in their youth. It is a delicate task for Louise as she uses more moisture to tackle the stubborn water stain. Mechanical maestro Steve Fletcher takes receipt of a 1950s toy rocket that once had sparks.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: S7 E8 — Chandelier, Mother of Pearl Table and Runway Plane Electrics expert Mark Stuckey and silversmith Brenton West join forces to repair a much-loved, sparkling chandelier that once took pride of place in a council house. Owner Suzanne's mum Pat worked as a cleaner for a wealthy couple who gifted her the cherished chandelier. A constant in her own childhood, Suzanne and her daughter Grace are delighted to return to see it back to its former glory.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.desc: S7 E9 — Drag Racing Cone, Penny Arcade Game and Mirror Ladies First up is a pinball penny slot machine, originally at the bar of a village pub run by owner Jeannine's family. From the late 1930s until the 1950s, her great-grandfather was the landlord at this local watering hole, and was then succeeded by her grandparents. Jeannine was brought up just opposite the pub, and this antique pinball machine now provides a tangible link to her predecessors.
programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: The Repair Shop
